name: What is the expected lifespan of a new shower or tub installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the expected lifespan of a new shower or tub installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a new shower or tub installation varies depending on the materials used, quality of installation, and how well it's maintained. High-quality fixtures and proper installation can last 15-20 years or more. Materials like cast iron tubs can last for decades, while acrylic or fiberglass units might have a slightly shorter lifespan but are still very durable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lifespan varies by materials and quality, with high-quality installations lasting 15-20 years or more.
